scripts.migrate: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then node --env-file=../../.env ../../node_modules/.bin/node-pg-migrate up --migrations-dir src/migrations --tsx; else ../../node_modules/.bin/node-pg-migrate up --migrations-dir src/migrations --tsx; fi'
scripts.migrate:down: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then node --env-file=../../.env ../../node_modules/.bin/node-pg-migrate down --migrations-dir src/migrations --tsx; else ../../node_modules/.bin/node-pg-migrate down --migrations-dir src/migrations --tsx; fi'
scripts.migrate:auto: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then node --env-file=../../.env --import tsx/esm src/bin/migrate.ts; else node --import tsx/esm src/bin/migrate.ts; fi'
